title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 TEK MATERNITETI I RI, BRRYLI
description_sq:
SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 TEK MATERNITETI I RI-BRRYLI
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat te ri te mireadministruar te pajisur me 2 ashensore dhe sistem kapot.
Organizohet ne nje korridor, ambient ndenje perfshi ambientin e gatimit, 1 ballkon, 2 dhoma gjumi dhe 1 tualet me dritare.
Arredimi eshte bere me arkitekt dhe apartamenti eshte i mobiluar me markat me prestigjoze dhe cilesore si ne elektroshtepiake ashtu edhe ne pajisjet hidrosanitare; i pajisur me kondicioner; totalisht i investuar dhe i shtruar me parket dhe me ndricim led.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
Zona ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode pasi ofron larmi sherbimesh, akses me transportin publik dhe privat, shkolla, kopshte, çerdhe, spitale, universitete shteterore dhe private, markete, bar kafe, restorante etj.
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE NEAR MATERNITETI NI, BRYLI
description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN RI-BRRYLI MATERNITY The apartment is located in a new, well-managed building equipped with 2 elevators and a hood system. It is organized in a corridor, living room including kitchen, 1 balcony, 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom with window. The furnishing was done by an architect and the apartment is furnished with the most prestigious and quality brands, both in electrical appliances and in hydrosanitary equipment; equipped with air conditioning; fully invested and laid with parquet and led lighting. It has regular mortgage documentation and is sold furnished as in the photo. The area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life as it offers a variety of services, access to public and private transport, schools, kindergartens, nurseries, hospitals, state and private universities, markets, coffee bars, restaurants, etc.
